records.description:
Between 1892 and 1893 Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria-Este and from 1886 until his death, heir presumptive to the Austro-Hungarian throne undertook a journey around the world. The travel route led Franz Ferdinand and his entourage from Trieste through the Suez Canal to India, where the group spent more than three months.

records.description: Franz Ferdinand (18 December 1863-28 June 1914) was Archduke of Austria-Este, and from 1896 until his death, heir presumptive to the Austro-Hungarian throne. Having fallen ill with lung tuberculosis for several times and on the advice of his doctors, Franz Ferdinand decided to go on a journey around the world from 1892-1893.
